statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies (ROC) - e-Services / Bermuda Online (BOL) filing portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the sole statutory language; the corporate name must be in Latin script and no transliteration is required. An exempted company's name must end with 'Limited' (or the approved abbreviation 'Ltd.') and must not be identical or deceptively similar to any name already registered in Bermuda.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / Banker / Banking (requires Bermuda Monetary Authority banking licence and ministerial consent)
Trust / Trust Company (requires BMA trust licence)
Insurance / Reinsurance / Assurance (requires BMA insurance registration)
Investment / Fund (requires BMA or other regulatory approval where applicable)
Royal / Imperial / Crown / Government / State / Commonwealth / Municipal (requires Crown or Ministerial approval)
University / College / Chartered / Chamber of Commerce (requires institutional consent)
Any name implying a connection with the Government of Bermuda or a foreign government
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant through its licensed CSP may request written reasons from the Registrar, submit a revised name, or file a formal written appeal with the Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the refusal. If the Registrar affirms the refusal, the applicant may apply to the Supreme Court of Bermuda for judicial review / appeal under section 14 of the Companies Act 1981, following Order 55 of the Rules of the Supreme Court 1985. A 30-day extension of the name reservation is available upon written application to the Registry before the original reservation expires.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for a Bermuda Exempted Company. Section 65 of the Companies Act 1981 requires a physical registered office situated in Bermuda, maintained by a licensed corporate service provider; the registered office must be staffed and hold the statutory records at that address. A virtual or remote-only office does not satisfy the statutory registered office requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate (approximately 30-40% over a three-year cycle). The Registrar of Companies, the Financial Intelligence Agency and the Bermuda Monetary Authority may conduct unannounced on-site inspections; the licensed CSP is subject to regulatory premises visits and client-file audits. Inspection risk increases if the hyper-casual gaming IP or ad-revenue management functions are perceived to be commercially managed or directed from within Bermuda.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 1981 (Bermuda), Part II and Part V (Exempted Companies), sections 6, 7, 10, 36, 64 and 129; Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966, section 13(2).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Department of Corporate Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation issued on the basis of the lodged Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; a Bermuda Exempted Company must issue at least one share fully paid, typically US$1.00, and no escrow account is required under Bermuda law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers hereby agree to subscribe for and accept the allotment of Ordinary Shares of US$1.00 each in the Company's authorized share capital to the incorporators; RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company be set at the place of business of the registered office provider in Bermuda and that the Registrar be notified accordingly; RESOLVED, that the following persons be appointed as officers: [Name] as Director, [Name] as Chief Executive Officer, [Name] as Secretary, and [Name] as Chief Financial Officer; RESOLVED, that such officers are authorized to execute bank account forms, marketing payment agreements, and all required regulatory filings for the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda (Name Clearance Section)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online name clearance application. The proposed exempted company name must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' and must not be misleading. A maximum of three name choices may be submitted. Pay any name reservation fee if applicable and await the Registrar's non-binding clearance.
required_dossiers: Statement of proposed authorized share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a similar name is already registered, the Registrar will issue a name conflict notification; the applicant must submit an alternative or add distinguishing words and resubmit within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting of constitutional documents and registered office selection
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Corporate Services Provider (agent) and Drafting Counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association in compliance with the Companies Act 1981 and Part V Exempted Company clauses. Select a Bermuda-licensed corporate service provider to act as registered office. Ensure the objects clause expressly covers software publishing, digital game distribution and mobile application monetization.
required_dossiers: Letter of authority from the incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the drafts require statutory amendments, the preparer will revise the documents; no filing with the Registrar is needed until execution, so a correction cycle has no public registry effect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and witnessing of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Arrange for each incorporator or subscriber (and, if corporate, its authorized signatory) to execute the Memorandum and Articles. Each signature must be witnessed by an adult witness or notary. If a corporate subscriber signs, a board resolution of the subscribing company evidencing the authority must be annexed.
required_dossiers: Witness statement / statutory declaration of subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any incomplete execution is discovered by the agent before filing; the documents are re-presented for signature at no cost to the client.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory filing with the Registrar and payment of government fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda (Filing Counter / Online E-Registration Portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 1 – Application for Incorporation together with the executed constitutional documents and registered office consent. Pay the official state filing fee of USD 2,350 (or the schedule in force at filing) by bank draft or approved electronic payment. Keep the numbered receipt for the record.
required_dossiers: Original Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certificate of Consent of the registered office provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition or defect notice, the agent must respond with corrected documents and any proposed amendments within 14 days; otherwise the application is deemed withdrawn and a fresh filing is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board resolution and appointment of officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial Directors / Members / First Board of the Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Certificate of Incorporation is issued, convene the first board meeting or pass a unanimous written resolution comprising the pro forma resolution set out above. Formally subscribe the shares, adopt the registered office, appoint the board of directors and officers, and authorize the opening of bank accounts with UK/Bermuda EMI institutions for AdMob and AppLovin payment rail settlements.
required_dossiers: Formal minutes or written resolution of the first board meeting
Consent to act of directors and officers
Share subscription list / register of members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any officer appointment creates a conflict, an extraordinary resolution may be passed to reappoint; such resolutions are internal and do not require public filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation statutory filings and tax registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda; Bermuda Tax Administration; National Pension Scheme Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within the prescribed post-incorporation window, apply for the Certificate of Tax Exemption under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 to guarantee no Bermuda corporate income tax until 2035, if not already automatic. Maintain statutory registers at the registered office. If the company hires employees in Bermuda, register with the National Pension Scheme and Payroll Tax; if it does not carry on business in Bermuda, apply for a Non-Resident Trade Licence Exemption if required.
required_dossiers: Statutory register of directors, officers and members
Payroll and social insurance registration forms (if staffed in Bermuda)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filings may be regularized under the Registrar's late filing procedures by submitting a declaration and paying the prescribed penalty; tax exemption applications filed within 12 months are accepted by the Minister of Finance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – no industrial licence triggered under the Bermuda Trade and Business Licensing Act 1973 for an exempted company carrying on digital publishing outside Bermuda; the Bermuda Gaming Commission is not engaged because the activity is non-gambling casual game software publishing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating license required – the business is categorized as the publishing of lightweight ad-monetized mobile games (ISIC 5820/NAICS 511210), a non-regulated information service.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not engaged – the Bermuda Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has no applicable trigger
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no physical project, no land development, and no construction; the activity is cloud-hosted and environment-neutral
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No discharge of wastewater, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), or solid waste; there are no industrial processes, no cooling systems, and no chemical storage; therefore national emission threshold regulations do not apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable at formation stage – the company maintains no physical plant, office floor, warehouse, or registered operational site. If a future Bermuda office is opened, the premises must comply with the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service requirements and occupational safety standards under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 1982, but such clearance is not a precondition to incorporation or digital operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda is a separate non-UK tax jurisdiction. The competent tax administration is the Office of the Tax Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Hamilton, Bermuda (tax functions administered through the Bermuda government portal at https://www.gov.bm). Company-law registration is with the Bermuda Registrar of Companies (Ministry of Finance); customs and export controls are with the Bermuda Customs Service. HM Revenue and Customs (United Kingdom) is not the registration authority for this Bermudian entity but is a counterparty for international information exchange and CFC legislation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign parent uses a Bermuda-licensed corporate service provider (CSP) to incorporate an Exempted Company with the Registrar of Companies under the Companies Act 1981. The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and a unique company number; the company simultaneously obtains a Certificate of Exemption under the Exempted Companies Act 1981 and is recorded as an exempted undertaking. No Bermudian TIN or VAT ID is issued on incorporation; the company number is the primary corporate identifier. If required for UK double-tax-relief or CFC analyses, the company may apply to the Office of the Tax Commissioner for a certificate of tax residence. Payroll-tax employer registration arises only if Bermuda-resident staff are employed; customs importer registration arises only on first physical import. If the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 applies (MNE group with global revenue of EUR 750m or more), the company must register as a constituent entity and receive a CIT reference. Otherwise, no further tax-ID registration obtains.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No Bermuda state-level check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists. Relevant elections and status choices: (i) registration as an exempted undertaking under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966, providing a statutory assurance against future Bermudian taxation (other than payroll, land, customs, and the 2023 CIT for in-scope groups); (ii) US check-the-box election on IRS Form 8832 (Bermuda exempted companies are not per se corporations under US Treasury Regulation §301.7701-2(b)), allowing classification as a disregarded entity, partnership, or corporation for US federal tax purposes; (iii) designation and annual declaration of 'relevant activity' status under the Economic Substance (Substance Requirements) Regulations 2018 for the entity's hyper-casual game publishing activity; and (iv) transition elections and safe-harbour elections available under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 (including asset-basis transitional elections and anti-hybrid elections) for in-scope MNE groups.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermudian dollar (BMD) is pegged to the US dollar (USD) at 1:1 and is freely convertible for non-resident exempted companies. Capital account transactions are generally permitted without prior exchange control approval where the exempted company is classified as non-resident, provided it does not carry on business in Bermuda and is beneficially owned by non-residents. Profit remittance and dividend distribution are unrestricted for such non-resident exempted companies; any transfer in foreign currency must be executed through an authorised dealer and may require a BMA notification or negative consent filing. Resident-engaged transactions and dealings in BMD may require exchange control permission under the Exchange Control Act 1972.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Bermuda imposes no mandatory surrender of export proceeds and no statutory conversion ratio for non-resident exempted companies. Export receipts denominated in foreign currency may be retained in foreign currency accounts and deployed for offshore operational expenditures. For entities treated as resident for exchange control purposes, the BMA may require foreign currency receipts to be offered to an authorised dealer for conversion into BMD within a specified period unless a general permission or specific exemption applies. The target Bermuda Exempted Company, operating as a non-resident publishing entity, is outside the scope of any surrender or conversion mandate.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Cross-border digital EMI onboarding for a Bermuda Exempted Company is rated Medium. Reputable UK and European electronic money institutions (e.g., Wise Business, Revolut Business) generally require a physical or registered presence in their licensing jurisdiction and may not accept Bermuda risk profiles. Bermuda itself has a regulated 'digital assets' fintech license but no EMI passporting regime equivalent to the EU/UK. Offshore EMIs in other low-tax jurisdictions may provide USD and EUR accounts, but legal constraints include limited ability to obtain bank identification codes and restrictions on serving gaming payment flows. The most viable arrangement is a Bermuda bank account at Butterfield or HSBC supplemented by an authorised-currency payout aggregator for AdMob/AppLovin proceeds.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors are not legally required to appear physically in Bermuda for corporate bank account opening, but most Tier 1 banks mandate a video-identification interview for at least one director, beneficial owner, and signatory. Remote account opening is permissible on a case-by-case basis using certified passport copies, notarised board resolutions, and banker's references, subject to the bank's AML/KYC policy and BMA guidance. Bermuda commercial banks will usually require a physical or virtual board meeting recorded in minutes to authorise account opening and signatory powers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore entity with a nominee director or complex ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Up-to-date register of directors, members, and beneficial owners; Bermuda Economic Substance Act compliance filing; certificate of incorporation; constitutional documents; board resolution authorising the bank account and specifying commercial purpose; source of wealth and source of funds declarations for the initial capital contribution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated entity with limited operating history and anticipated high-volume, low-value advertising payouts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed publisher agreements with AdMob and AppLovin; platform payout schedules and historical revenue statements (if available); detailed business plan and cash-flow forecast; audited or management financial statements; AML transaction monitoring framework; customer and counterparty due diligence policies for payment flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border fund movements to a zero-tax jurisdiction from UK and US counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Group structure chart evidencing commercial substance; intercompany service agreements with transfer pricing documentation; board minutes demonstrating central management and control exercised in Bermuda; BMA exchange control approvals or legal opinions confirming non-resident status; tax residency confirmation from the Bermuda Tax Commissioner.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound share capital injections should be routed via SWIFT MT103 from the UK or US parent account to the Bermuda Exempted Company's operational account at an authorised dealer bank. The remittance advice must clearly state 'Capital Contribution to Bermuda Exempted Company' and cite the applicable payment purpose code (e.g., OECD/EU purpose code 'T210' for equity capital or equivalent BMA exchange control category). BMD is the local currency, but foreign currency wires are accepted; conversion into USD or BMD is executed at the receiving bank's prevailing rate. Verification at receipt includes BMA exchange control notification (where required), beneficial ownership disclosure, source of funds documentation, and copy of the executed board resolution approving the capital injection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational trade disbursements are cleared through SWIFT MT103 for supplier payments, licensing fees, and contractor compensation, with correspondent banking via USD clearing (CHIPS and Fedwire) given the BMD-USD peg. For distribution and co-publishing contracts, commercial letters of credit (UCP600) may be utilised for larger settlement amounts, issued by Butterfield or HSBC and confirmed through international correspondent banks. AdMob and AppLovin payouts are received in USD via ACH, SWIFT, or payout aggregators into the Bermuda operational account under normalised remittance references matching the publisher ID and advertising settlement statement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright or ordinary forward foreign exchange contracts with an authorised dealer for USD/BMD, USD/GBP, and USD/EUR
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) where BMD is treated as a reference currency and settled in USD
Cross-currency swaps for matched funding of intercompany loans or capital accounts
FX options (call and put) acquired for hedging the prospective cash flows from UK and EU advertising revenue

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form 1) and Annual Government Fee – Companies Act 1981 s.116
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda (Companies and Land Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after the anniversary of incorporation each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of 10% per month or part thereof; continued non-filing triggers Registrar's notice and administrative strike-off of the company from the Register; directors may be subject to daily default fines.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Certificate of Compliance – Companies Act 1981 s.95
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days of the anniversary of incorporation concurrently with the Annual Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Offence by company and every officer; default fine per day; persistent failure may lead to dissolution or strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Declaration – Economic Substance Act 2018
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Registrar of Companies (Economic Substance Division)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the end of the relevant financial year (mandatory annual ES return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Pecuniary penalties up to BMD 250,000 (USD 250,000) for non-compliance and potential further daily fines; Registrar may strike off for failure to file.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Annual Confirmation – Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2017
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies (Central Beneficial Ownership Register maintained by the Registrar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Confirmation submitted annually with the Annual Return within 60 days of the anniversary date and updated within 30 days of any share transfer or change of beneficial owner
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to BMD 25,000 (USD 25,000) plus daily default fines; director disqualification and conviction penalties for knowingly providing false information.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit or filing of financial statements required for a Bermuda Exempted Company unless it is a licensed financial institution, regulated under the Digital Asset Business Act 2018, a listed/traded company, or a public-interest enterprise; a hyper-casual games publishing company with no Bermuda-regulated activity is outside mandatory audit requirements, though the board may resolve an audit or shareholders holding at least 10% may request one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Companies Act 1981 requires true and fair accounts; IFRS or US GAAP are acceptable frameworks in Bermuda; if an audit is performed, the auditor must be recognized under the Public Accountants Act 2007.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Upon each anniversary, the resident representative and directors must verify the Beneficial Ownership Register against the share register and notify the Registrar of any transfer-driven changes; the Annual Return must be accompanied by confirmation that the beneficial ownership records held locally and in the Central Register are complete, accurate, and up to date at the confirmation date.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registered Office and Resident Representative record

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 2,000 – USD 4,500 annually for Bermuda resident agent, registered office, and corporate secretarial services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required for this entity type; voluntary IFRS/US GAAP audit if commissioned typically ranges USD 15,000 – USD 30,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% general corporate income tax for Bermuda Exempted Companies outside the scope of the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 (CITA); 15% CIT applies solely to constituent entities of in-scope multinational groups with consolidated revenue of EUR 750 million or more in at least two of the preceding four fiscal years, effective for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2025.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective 0% rate for ordinary out-of-scope Exempted Companies. Statutory protection from future Bermudian taxes until 31 March 2035 under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 (renewable); no capital gains tax, no value-added tax, no goods and services tax, and no payroll tax unless the company employs Bermuda-resident personnel. An Exempted Company may apply for a written Tax Exemption Certificate from the Minister of Finance (one-time fee) evidencing the 0% guarantee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance (ES) Return / Annual ES Declaration - Form ES01 filed via BERA (Bermuda Electronic Registry Application), administered by the Registrar of Companies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within six (6) months after the end of the financial year (e.g., 30 June for a 31 December year-end).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered legal name, company registration number, registered office address in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the licensed Bermuda registered office address; a UK or overseas correspondence address is permitted only as a secondary line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration whether the entity is tax resident in a jurisdiction outside Bermuda and, if so, the jurisdiction name.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If UK directors exercise central management and control in the UK, HMRC may deem the company UK tax resident; the declaration must truthfully disclose this, and the entity should expect automatic information exchange with HMRC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Yes/No election: does the entity carry on a relevant activity under the Economic Substance Regulations 2018?
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A hyper-casual mobile game publisher exploiting owned game IP is typically an 'IP business' or 'distribution and service centre'; answering 'No' when ad-monetization IP income is derived from game titles is a high-risk misdeclaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income (BMD) attributable to the relevant activity for the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report AdMob and AppLovin payouts, in-app purchase and ad-revenue-share income attributable to Bermudian-incorporated publishing contracts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full-time equivalent employees physically present in Bermuda performing core income-generating activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A zero-employee return converts the filing into an automatic substance-test failure for IP businesses; fully remote, UK-based engineering and ad-ops teams count as zero Bermuda employees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual operating expenditure (BMD) incurred in Bermuda for the relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Subsistence-level service fees paid to a Bermuda corporate service provider are generally disregarded; genuine local payroll and office rent are the decisive evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 - Place of Core Income-Generating Activities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Jurisdiction where the core income-generating activities are actually conducted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If strategic decisions, game IP licensing and ad-rate negotiations occur in the UK, the accurate entry is the United Kingdom, triggering CIGA failure and UK-residence exposure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of physical office/premises in Bermuda and whether board meetings are held in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee-registered premises without actual management meetings do not satisfy the physical-presence test.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the ES Return: default fine of BMD 10,000 plus continued penalty of BMD 1,000 per day of default, risk of strike-off, and automatic exchange of information with UK HMRC and US IRS. Knowingly false declarations: criminal fines and imprisonment up to 2 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Return (Registrar of Companies) - filed through BERA under the Companies Act 1981 (as amended by the Companies (Annual Returns) Amendment Act 2022).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before 31 January in respect of the status of the company as at 31 December of the preceding calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office address in Bermuda maintained by a licensed corporate services provider.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The office must be staffed and accessible in Bermuda; a PO box is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, dates of birth and residential addresses of all directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: UK-resident directors controlling the Bermuda board must be disclosed; HMRC receives this data under the UK-Bermuda TIEA.
Disclose ultimate parents and intermediate holding companies on the chain.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ultimate beneficial owner(s) (natural persons holding 25% or more) filed on the Bermuda Beneficial Ownership Register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: UK founders holding via nominee structures must be disclosed; concealment triggers AML penalties and cross-border information sharing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name of the Bermuda-resident secretary (individual or licensed firm).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The secretary must hold a Bermuda trust licence or be a practising lawyer/accountant in Bermuda.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Default penalty of BMD 200 per month of non-filing, suspension of certificate of compliance, automatic strike-off after persistent default, and disqualification of directors from acting as directors of any Bermuda company.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Return (CIT Return) - administered by the Bermuda Tax Administration Agency (TAA) online portal; applicable ONLY to in-scope MNE groups under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 15 months after the end of the fiscal year (first returns for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2025).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bermuda-source and apportioned income as computed under CITA 2023.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Out-of-scope exempted companies are not required to register or file; in-scope groups must consolidate each constituent entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjustments to income to reflect arm's length results under the Corporate Income Tax (Transfer Pricing) Rules 2024.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Same documentation standard as OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; no TP file applies below the EUR 750 million group threshold.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 19 - GloBE Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-Up Tax (QDMTT)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of Bermuda QDMTT to bring effective rate to 15% for in-scope entities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Applies only to constituents of groups with EUR 750 million or more consolidated revenue; a standalone hyper-casual games company is outside scope.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file: BMD 100,000 maximum penalty for deliberate non-compliance plus daily default surcharges, interest on unpaid CIT at the statutory TAA rate, and containment/strike-off measures; directors of the Bermuda entity may be named on penalty certificates.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Bermuda imposes no withholding tax on dividends. Distributions by a Bermuda Exempted Company to UK or any foreign shareholders are made gross without any Bermudian deduction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable for Bermuda-side relief: Bermuda has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network and does not levy withholding taxes, so no treaty-relief application or Tax Residency Certificate is needed for outbound dividends. The UK-Bermuda relationship is governed by the Tax Information Exchange Agreement (information exchange only), not a double tax treaty. Where a foreign payor (e.g., a UK or US counterparty) withholds on a payment to the Bermuda company, the company may claim foreign domestic law exemptions or treaty benefits available under the counterparty jurisdiction's rules; for US-source ad-platform payments, a US-sourced FDAP 30% withholding exposure may arise and a properly completed IRS Form W-8BEN-E (claiming the applicable business-profits exemption) should be maintained. The Bermuda Ministry of Finance may issue a Tax Exemption Certificate confirming the 0% regime where a counterparty requires formal proof.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate for outbound royalties and interest; Bermuda does not impose withholding tax on interest or IP royalties. Because no comprehensive double taxation treaties exist, no reduced treaty rates apply. Inbound: ad-platform service fees from Google Ireland/APAC and AppLovin are business profits, not royalties, and are not subject to Irish/APAC withholding; mischaracterization of game-IP license fees payable to a Bermuda parent as service fees is a classic fatal red flag.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: BMD 750,000,000 (pegged 1:1 to USD) consolidated annual group revenue - the CITA in-scope threshold triggering mandatory Bermuda TP documentation, Master File/Local File and CbCR-aligned filings under the Corporate Income Tax (Transfer Pricing) Rules 2024. Below this threshold, no statutory Bermuda TP file is required for out-of-scope exempted companies; however, upon UK tax-residence reclassification, UK transfer pricing rules (TIOPA 2010 Part 4) apply immediately without any de minimis threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations 2018 apply to every registered Bermuda entity. 'IP business' (exploitation of game IP, including ad-monetized hyper-casual titles) and 'distribution and service centre' (delivery of digital game services to related parties) are designated relevant activities. The company must: (i) file an annual ES Return, (ii) conduct core income-generating activities in Bermuda, (iii) maintain adequate physical presence, employees and expenditure in Bermuda proportionate to income, and (iv) for IP businesses apply the OECD nexus approach requiring local R&D, branding or product development activity. A zero-substance Bermuda entity deriving AdMob/AppLovin ad revenue from game IP is a designated high-risk case subject to enhanced scrutiny and automatic information exchange with HMRC and the IRS.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Economic Substance Failure / Shell Company (IP Business)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Bermuda Exempted Company earns substantial ad-monetization revenue from hyper-casual game IP through AdMob and AppLovin payouts but has no physical office, no employees, no Bermuda expenditure, and no substantive board meetings in Bermuda; game development, ad-ops and strategic decisions are performed in the UK.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR 2018: penalty up to BMD 250,000 for IP businesses failing the substance test; BMD 10,000 default penalty for non-filing plus BMD 1,000 per day; automatic comprehensive information exchange with UK HMRC/IRS; cancellation of the tax exemption certificate; strike-off from the Bermuda register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for fines and costs where the company fails to remedy; disqualification from acting as director of any Bermuda company; departure prevention orders (travel bans) may be issued against directors for unpaid penalties; criminal liability for knowingly false ES declarations with imprisonment up to 2 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: UK Corporation Tax Evasion / Deemed UK Tax Residence
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Central management and control of the Bermuda company is exercised in the UK: UK-resident founders hold board meetings in London, sign AdMob/AppLovin agreements in the UK, and direct game publishing strategy from the UK, causing HMRC to treat the company as UK tax resident under common law regardless of Bermuda incorporation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: UK corporation tax at up to 25% on worldwide profits (19% small-profits rate where applicable) with backdating to the commencement of UK control; statutory interest on unpaid tax; penalties up to 200% of the tax for deliberate concealment; potential CbCR and public country-by-country reporting obligations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Senior accounting officer and director penalties of GBP 5,000 per uncorrected failure (FA 2009); personal liability for fraudulent tax evasion with imprisonment up to 7 years (TMA 1970); HMRC may issue charging orders over personally-held game IP or commercial contracts where value has been diverted.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Bermuda entity allocates ad revenue or licenses game IP to connected UK/EU operating companies without arm's length compensation; alternatively, after a strategic acquisition the group crosses the EUR 750 million revenue threshold and fails to register, file CIT returns, or maintain Master File/Local File documentation in Bermuda.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CITA 2023 and TP Rules 2024: primary TP adjustments bringing taxable profits to 15% CIT; interest and penalties up to BMD 100,000 for non-compliance; in parallel, HMRC may apply TIOPA 2010 Part 4 adjustments with penalties up to 100% of underpaid UK tax and, for offshore asset arrangements, penalties up to 200%.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who knowingly sign false TP documentation or facilitate profit shifting face personal fines in Bermuda and, in the UK, liability under the Criminal Finances Act 2017 for failure to prevent facilitation of tax evasion - unlimited fines and imprisonment of directing minds up to 7 years on conviction.
